text:
Benign Prostatic Hyperplasia is anon-cancerous enlargement of the prostate
causing clinical symptoms. Its increase in size impacts on the urethra and
partially or completely obstructs urine outflow.
A common cause of lower urinary tract obstruction among elderly males and
pathological enlargement occurs usually after the age of 40.
Symptoms are due to mechanical obstruction (static cause) or spasm of the
smooth muscles in the prostate and around the bladder neck.
